rules.sentence: Histopathologic features of rosacea include dilated vessels, lymphohistiocytic infiltration in the perifollicular and perivascular areas, neutrophils in the intrafollicular region, and dermal edema.
Seborrheic dermatitis is characterized by spongiosis, psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia, and parakeratosis concentrated around follicular openings, often described as shoulder parakeratosis.
Chronic lesions show prominent psoriasiform hyperplasia and parakeratosis, closely resembling psoriasis histologically.
